sentences.text: under Sections 363, 366A, 376(2)(n), 376(3) IPC and under Section 5m/6, 5(j)(ii)/6 of POCSO Act.
We have heard learned counsel for the appellant.
We have also perused the impugned judgment.

I n the light of the findings of the Special Court which are based on critical evaluation of the evidence on record, conclusion of acquittal drawn particularly in view of paragraphs 34, 35 of the impugned judgment is found to be impregnable.
Consequently, present appeal stands dismissed.
(ROHIT ARYA) (SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH)
